name: university-ai-compute-fabric
description: Impl-1 build of the **AI Operations Copilot** for the Academic AI Compute Fabric: a read-only, evidence-grounded assistant that explains operational questions (access denials, schedule windows, node triage) from a **simulated** fleet (31 × 24 GB workstations + 1 server with 2 × 48 GB GPUs). No GPU, cluster or network is needed.
